title: All Should Be Equal in the Eyes of Language Models: Counterfactually Aware Fair Text Generation
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks religious bias as one of its primary sensitive attributes. It uses datasets like StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, and BOLD to measure 'Religion' as a specific category, providing quantitative results in Tables 1 and 2 and qualitative analysis of prompts related to religious topics (e.g., Islam).
